admission.justification: The generated files, the source read and the start notification jointly keep the detailed record reachable when a response boundary limits text.

guarantee: A reader can recover governing file knowledge from its selected task memory. A current source brief contains the detail omitted from a bounded reply, and a reply marks missing or older disk detail until a covering write. An eligible converted role start gives the recipient a separate change report.
title: File knowledge through briefs and start notices
